title: Asmodensius (Creature #1): Pre-Registered Controlled Empirical Discoveries & Null Results Ledger (DISCOVERIES.md, R20)

summary: 408-line open empirical discovery log documenting controlled experimental findings in a tokenless, LLM-free artificial organism (grown vs i.i.d. wiring foraging gain, dream confabulation of certainty, aleatoric/epistemic uncertainty conflation, volatility-scaled forgetting) alongside honest null results (N09/N13) and ~98 controlled run logs.
